statement: Define V(a,b) = XOR of matrix[i][j] over all i,j with 0 <= i <= a < m and 0 <= j <= b < n. Let G(v) = the number of pairs (a,b) with 0 <= a < m, 0 <= b < n and V(a,b) > v, and let C(v) = the number of pairs (a,b) with 0 <= a < m, 0 <= b < n and V(a,b) >= v. The function returns a result r such that G(r) < k and C(r) >= k. Equivalently, if the m*n coordinate values V(a,b) are sorted in non-increasing order (one entry per coordinate, duplicates kept), then r is the k-th entry of that sorted list.
preconditions: Let m = len(matrix) and n = len(matrix[0]). The slice matrix is non-empty (m >= 1), every row is non-empty and has the same length n (so n >= 1), m <= 1000, n <= 1000, for every i,j with 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n we have 0 <= matrix[i][j] <= 10^6, and 1 <= k <= m*n.
